# Bundled TorrServer

- Upstream project: https://github.com/YouROK/TorrServer
- Release: `MatriX.145`
- Binary: official `TorrServer-darwin-arm64`
- SHA-256: `2b1d47a2b6c57f891413fe19e28439647b3b7f02b751b8a129d848770308e864`
- License: GPL-3.0; see `LICENSE`.
- `default-settings.json` supplies upstream defaults with Bonjour, DLNA, LPD and UPnP disabled for the local app-managed instance.

The app target is arm64-only. The bundled process is managed by KinoStream and binds to `127.0.0.1`.
